label: Bible Study
prompt: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art _____ to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
verse: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
note: Heaven's new song — the Lamb alone can open the sealed book, because he was slain and redeemed us.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy _____, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verse: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
note: Faith passed on at home: talk of God's words sitting, walking, lying down and rising up.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as _____ for sweetness.
verse: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
note: Ezekiel was told to eat the scroll — and God's word tasted as sweet as honey.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou shalt not go up and down as a _____ among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
verse: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
note: The Law bans spreading gossip — right next to standing idly by while your neighbor's life is in danger.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be _____ from thee.
verse: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
note: Job's final confession: God can do every thing, and 'no thought can be withholden from thee.' The questions finally rest.
